Path to a coord CLI that runs `pr publish-record` against a remote DB (e.g. <HOME>/.local/bin/coord-ssh). The host forwards its PublishResult JSON to the remote CLI; the remote re-validates the mirror and (on success) upserts the remote task mirror. The remote CLI never invokes `gh`. .py paths are auto-prepended with sys.executable for Windows hosts. When this flag is set, the host ALSO runs a remote `pr publish-preflight` using the same path BEFORE any `gh` call, unless overridden by --preflight-event-cli-path.

Optional override for the preflight CLI path. When set, the host runs a remote `pr publish-preflight` first; if it fails (mirror_conflict or unknown_workspace), the host DOES NOT invoke `gh pr create` and returns a `publish.blocked` envelope with code 1. This is how the host guarantees no GitHub write happens before the remote state has been re-validated. If omitted but --event-cli-path is set, the same path is used automatically.

                             [--validation VALIDATION] [--event-cli-path EVENT_CLI_PATH]
                             [--preflight-event-cli-path PREFLIGHT_EVENT_CLI_PATH]
                             workspace_id

positional arguments:
  workspace_id

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --task-id TASK_ID
  --repo REPO           GitHub repo in owner/name form
  --branch BRANCH       Worker branch name
  --head-owner HEAD_OWNER
                        GitHub owner of the head branch (often the same as the repo owner)
  --base BASE           Target base branch on GitHub (e.g. main). Must be explicit to avoid cross-
                        repo confusion.
  --title TITLE
  --body BODY           PR body; empty allowed. Will not be treated as trusted input.
  --commit COMMIT       Full 40-char worker commit SHA
  --pushed PUSHED       Strict true|false; reported by worker host about its own push.
  --actor ACTOR
  --remote REMOTE       Audit-only remote name, e.g. origin
  --validation VALIDATION
                        Short validation summary from worker
  --event-cli-path EVENT_CLI_PATH
                        Path to a coord CLI that runs `pr publish-record` against a remote DB
                        (e.g. <HOME>/.local/bin/coord-ssh). The host forwards its PublishResult
                        JSON to the remote CLI; the remote re-validates the mirror and (on
                        success) upserts the remote task mirror. The remote CLI never invokes
                        `gh`. .py paths are auto-prepended with sys.executable for Windows hosts.
                        When this flag is set, the host ALSO runs a remote `pr publish-preflight`
                        using the same path BEFORE any `gh` call, unless overridden by
                        --preflight-event-cli-path.
  --preflight-event-cli-path PREFLIGHT_EVENT_CLI_PATH
                        Optional override for the preflight CLI path. When set, the host runs a
                        remote `pr publish-preflight` first; if it fails (mirror_conflict or
                        unknown_workspace), the host DOES NOT invoke `gh pr create` and returns a
                        `publish.blocked` envelope with code 1. This is how the host guarantees no
                        GitHub write happens before the remote state has been re-validated. If
                        omitted but --event-cli-path is set, the same path is used automatically.

usage: coordinate assignment [-h]
                             {request,accept,handoff,blocker,unblock,closeout,review-result,mark-done,mark-done-prepare,mark-done-preflight,mark-done-claim,mark-done-apply,mark-done-files,mark-done-record}
                             ...

positional arguments:
  {request,accept,handoff,blocker,unblock,closeout,review-result,mark-done,mark-done-prepare,mark-done-preflight,mark-done-claim,mark-done-apply,mark-done-files,mark-done-record}
    request             Request a task assignment
    accept              Accept a task assignment
    handoff             Hand off a task to another agent
    blocker             Raise a blocker on a task
    unblock             Resolve a blocker on a task
    closeout            Request closeout review for a task
    review-result       Submit a review result for a task
    mark-done           Mark a task as done
    mark-done-prepare   Validate the closeout/review gate on the control plane and issue a one-
                        time completion.authorized receipt binding the host-aware mark-done files
                        + record pair.
    mark-done-preflight
                        Read-only: re-query a receipt from the control-plane DB and return its
                        authoritative workspace/task/status/expiry. The coding host calls this
                        through coord-ssh before mutating the canonical checklist so it never
                        trusts its own claims.
    mark-done-claim     Atomically reserve a receipt authorized -> claimed on the control plane,
                        recording before/expected-after fingerprints. Server-side sink invoked by
                        the coding host through coord-ssh BEFORE the checklist mutation (two-phase
                        reserve step).
    mark-done-apply     Acknowledge a claimed receipt -> applied on the control plane, recording
                        the actual after-fingerprint. Server-side sink invoked by the coding host
                        through coord-ssh AFTER the canonical checklist write lands (two-phase
                        apply step).
    mark-done-files     Coding-host half of host-aware mark-done. Writes local checklist file half
                        only. Normal path requires --receipt and a remote coord CLI (--event-cli-
                        path) to verify/claim the receipt online before any file mutation.
                        --repair-reason selects the explicit repair-only path.
    mark-done-record    Server half of host-aware mark-done. Writes the control-plane task.done
                        event after re-verifying the receipt and the deployed harness. Normal path
                        requires --receipt; --repair-reason selects the explicit repair-only path.

  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
